text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Translations

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/**'
      - 'pubspec.yaml'

jobs:
  regenerate-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "stable"
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils globally
        run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate translations
        run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filter: '^lib/l10n/'

      - name: Create PR if changes detected
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.added != '' || steps.check_changes.outputs.modified != ''
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=pr_title::Regenerated Translations"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_body::This PR regenerates the translations based on the updated strings."
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.added != '' || steps.check_changes.outputs.modified != ''
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add lib/generated
          git commit -m "Regenerate translations"
          git push origin HEAD:regenerate-translations
```
